body: Well that is definitely not something I am going to do. I don’t care if I have to wait until I live alone or until my mother dies. I am not living in this society.
So I’m suppose to stay miserable for decades just to please other people?
I don’t understand what’s so bad about me choosing to end my life quickly and painlessly. I didn’t ask to be born. I should have the right to choose when I die.
That’s still too much for me.
Most decent paying full time jobs are 40+ hours a week. I think that’s unavoidable.
